subject: general
question: Which government scheme aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from economically weaker sections for pursuing higher education?

options.text: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students

solution:
The correct answer is __**Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

 
 
• The **Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students** was introduced by the **Ministry of Education (formerly MHRD)** to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from **economically weaker sections** for pursuing higher education. 
 
• The scheme primarily targets students scoring above the **80th percentile** in their respective board examinations in class 12 and belonging to families with an annual income of less than **₹8 lakhs**. 
 
• It aims to **reduce the dropout rate** in higher education and increase the enrollment of students from underprivileged backgrounds in universities and colleges across India. 
 
• The scholarship amount is disbursed directly into the bank accounts of students through the **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)** system, ensuring transparency and efficiency.
